cases.description: external_dependencies is empty, so zero flags fire — but that is treated as ambiguous, not as a clean bill of health. It could mean the repo genuinely has no dependencies, or it could mean the manifests live somewhere codebase-intelligence's root-level-only parser doesn't look. report.warnings explicitly names this ambiguity, and suggested_risk_level is REQUIRES_REVIEW rather than CLEAR, deliberately failing closed instead of reporting a false-clean result.
cases.grounding: report.py appends a warning when ci_context.dependencies is empty; risk_scorer.compute_risk_level returns REQUIRES_REVIEW whenever dependency_count==0, regardless of the (empty) flags list.
